title: Cosmic Fire Hare
description: A vibrant, stylized hare leaps across a dark, surreal landscape, its body composed of flowing flames and glowing patterns in orange, teal, purple, and blue. The night sky features a crescent moon, dripping golden liquid, constellation-like text, and swirling colorful clouds above a fiery, undulating terrain.
prompt: A dynamic leaping hare made of flowing fire and glowing psychedelic patterns in vibrant orange, teal, purple and blue, running across a dark rolling landscape at night. The sky contains a glowing crescent moon with dripping golden liquid, constellation lines with text, and swirling colorful clouds. Surreal fantasy style with expressive brushwork and luminous colors.
